name: Missile Weapon Shop
desc1: This small, somewhat poorly-kept shop is full of all sorts of ranged
desc2: weapons. Most of them are quite shabbily crafted, but some are good,
desc3: and a select few are even skillfully made. A long wooden counter up
desc4: against the wall displays some of the better wares available here. The
desc5: The only exit is onto Dagger street, to the south.
